item.title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
item.description: The Pentagon said the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan would be livestreamed on December 3. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Wednesday the execution would be public. Hasan was convicted of killing 13 people and injuring 32 in a 2009 shooting at the Texas military base. Publicado también por: Al Jazeera English, The Hindu - International, France 24 - English. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: German ex-spy chief arrested for suspected espionage, treason
item.description: A former German spy chief was arrested Tuesday on suspicion of espionage and treason, an embarrassing case at a time when the country is seeking to broaden the powers of its intelligence agencies. item.title: Webb captures commotion from nebula's stellar jets
item.description: The NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope has unveiled numerous stars formerly hidden by clouds of dust in a stellar nursery known as NGC 7129—a cauldron of cosmic creation, 3,300 light-years from Earth. Webb captured infrared light, which pierces through the dense matter that scatters or absorbs other types of light. This region, rife with stellar objects in different stages of their lives, offers an opportunity to explore how stars shape their surroundings. Publicado también por: NASA, European Space Agency.
